topic: From Campus to Career: Chemical Engineering Pathways Unveiled
title: From Campus to Career: Chemical Engineering Pathways Unveiled
session_title: From Campus to Career: Chemical Engineering Pathways Unveiled
abstract: Brief description of workshop: This session will feature a panel of ChemE’s from the Young Professionals Committee (YPC) who are currently pursuing a variety of different career paths, from graduate school to industry to government jobs. Panelists will discuss what a typical day looks like in their current roles, career decisions they made to get there, uncertainties they pushed through, and pros and cons of different careers. This panel will provide a great overview of many different career options for ChemE’s. Panelists will also discuss how AIChE engagement after graduation helps in their unique career path.
